type_system.note: Candidate annotation contracts only; names and types do not redefine the locally unavailable IR v0.2 registry.

types.name: RowSet
types.description: Zero or more table rows preserving row identity.

types.name: String
types.description: Text usable as a query or value.

types.name: ValueSet
types.description: Zero or more typed scalar values.

types.name: EntitySet
types.description: Entity-denoting values with optional link identity.

types.name: DocumentSet
types.description: Retrieved or linked documents with provenance.

types.name: TextSpanSet
types.description: Text spans paired with document provenance.

types.name: KeyedValueSet
types.description: Values paired with candidate keys for back-mapping.

types.name: ComparedValueSet
types.description: Keyed values annotated with comparison outcomes or ordering.

types.name: GroupedValues
types.description: Values partitioned by one or more semantic keys.

types.name: ComparisonResult
types.description: A boolean, relation, or ordering result.

operators.name: FILTER
operators.purpose: Restrict rows by a declared predicate.
operators.semantics: Return exactly those input rows satisfying the grounded predicate while preserving row identity.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: RowSet is preserved across the operation.

executability.rationale: Predicates map to deterministic table filtering.

composability.rationale: RowSet output composes with projection and joins.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: One predicate application is a stable medium-level unit.

annotation_stability.rationale: Column and predicate agreement has not been measured.

known_risks: Compound predicates may require explicit conjunction semantics

operators.name: PROJECT
operators.purpose: Read one or more declared fields from rows while preserving association keys when required.
operators.semantics: Map rows to field values or entities; row identity must remain available when a later back-map is required.

output_ports.name: values
output_ports.description: Projected values, optionally keyed by row.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: Key-preserving and unkeyed outputs share one operator.

composability.rationale: Projected values feed retrieval, comparison, and answers.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: Reading a declared field is a reusable unit.

annotation_stability.rationale: Projection and key-preservation agreement has not been measured.

known_risks: Dropping row identity can make later back-mapping impossible

operators.name: RETRIEVE
operators.purpose: Locate linked or searched documents relevant to subject entities or a query.
operators.semantics: Return provenance-bearing document candidates without extracting the requested answer span.

input_ports.name: subjects
input_ports.description: Entities or query terms that scope retrieval.

reusability.rationale: Document location recurs across attributes and schemas.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: DocumentSet cleanly separates location from extraction.

executability.rationale: Depends on linked-document and retriever availability.

composability.rationale: DocumentSet feeds extraction while retaining provenance.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: Document acquisition is distinct from content reading.

annotation_stability.rationale: Linked versus search retrieval choices need pilot review.

known_risks: Oracle document IDs can leak if selection provenance is not recorded

operators.name: EXTRACT
operators.purpose: Extract an attribute-bearing span or value from documents.
operators.semantics: Read the requested attribute from each relevant document and preserve the subject/document association.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: Span and already-typed value outputs remain a union.

composability.rationale: Outputs feed parsing, comparison, or joins.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: Sentence selection and span extraction are fused at medium granularity.

annotation_stability.rationale: Attribute boundary and cardinality agreement need measurement.

known_risks: Reader failure must not be mislabeled as semantic-plan failure

operators.name: JOIN
operators.purpose: Associate values or selected keys with their originating rows or entities.
operators.semantics: Match declared keys while preserving multiplicity and provenance; includes back-mapping after selection.

input_ports.name: right
input_ports.description: Right keyed collection or selected keys.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: Several keyed collection types are accepted.

composability.rationale: Join reconnects modality-derived values to answer rows.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: Keyed association is a distinct dependency.

annotation_stability.rationale: Join necessity and key choice have not been reviewed.

known_risks: Implicit row identity can make an explicit join appear unnecessary

operators.name: AGGREGATE
operators.purpose: Reduce values globally or by declared groups.
operators.semantics: Apply COUNT, SUM, MIN, MAX, AVG, or another reviewed aggregate with explicit grouping and empty-set behavior.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: Input and grouped output distinctions are explicit.

composability.rationale: Aggregate values feed comparison and answers.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: One declared reduction is a stable unit.

annotation_stability.rationale: Grouping and empty-set agreement are unmeasured.

known_risks: MIN or MAX can be confused with ARG_EXTREME when an associated entity is requested

operators.name: COMPARE
operators.purpose: Apply an equality, ordering, temporal, or set comparison to typed values.
operators.semantics: Produce a relation result or comparison-annotated keyed values without performing answer back-mapping.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: Comparison is separate from winner selection.

executability.rationale: Parsed typed values support deterministic comparison.

known_risks: Unparsed strings can yield invalid lexical comparisons

operators.name: PARSE
operators.purpose: Convert text spans or surface values into declared typed values.
operators.semantics: Parse and minimally normalize a declared value type while recording failures and raw text.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: Surface input and typed output are distinct.

executability.rationale: Common formats can be parsed deterministically.

composability.rationale: Typed values feed all reasoning operators.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: Parsing and normalization are fused at medium granularity.

annotation_stability.rationale: Need evidence on when parsing is explicitly annotated.

known_risks: Locale and unit conversion may deserve separate fine-grained nodes

operators.name: ARG_EXTREME
operators.purpose: Select candidate keys attaining an extremum or requested ordinal.
operators.semantics: Return all or a question-specified subset of keys whose values satisfy the declared rank and tie policy.

input_ports.name: values
input_ports.description: Comparable values paired with candidate keys.

argument_slots.name: ordering
argument_slots.description: Minimum, maximum, rank, and tie policy.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: Keys are returned rather than bare extreme values.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: Selection is separated from comparison and mapping.

annotation_stability.rationale: Tie and ordinal policies need pilot evidence.

known_risks: Using AGGREGATE MIN instead loses the associated candidate

operators.name: ARITHMETIC
operators.purpose: Compute a declared arithmetic expression over typed values.
operators.semantics: Apply an ordered arithmetic function with explicit units, rounding, and divide-by-zero behavior where relevant.

typed_contract_clarity.rationale: Typed operands and result are explicit.

composability.rationale: Scalar results feed comparison or answers.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: A complex expression could hide multiple elementary steps.

known_risks: Operand order and units can be silently wrong

operators.name: DISTINCT
operators.purpose: Remove duplicates using declared identity semantics.
operators.semantics: Return first-occurrence-stable unique items under exact, normalized-string, or entity-identity equivalence.

composability.rationale: Output substitutes directly for input collections.

semantic_atomicity.rationale: One identity-based set operation is applied.

annotation_stability.rationale: Need evidence on implicit versus explicit distinctness.

known_risks: Entity alias normalization may be mistaken for exact string deduplication

rejected_patterns.reason: Attribute identity belongs in grounding, not the operator name.
Question-template macros are not reusable primitives.

exception_requirements: Demonstrate reuse across multiple questions and schemas
Report pilot frequency, contexts, ambiguity, and reviewer agreement

known_global_risks: Still provisional until annotated pilot evidence exists
Some operators expose union types that may weaken type checking
Graph length and reviewer agreement are not yet measured
